statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-mode audit. The requested .bw URL redirected to the UK canonical site; that observed behavior is included in scope.

page.notes: Requested Botswana host redirected through four documents to https://betway.com/en-gb/. Audited the reachable landing, sports, casino, and linked legal failure templates. Login/signup completion was not exercised because it leaves the landing for a regulated real-money account journey and would require personal data.

paths.description: Requested Botswana entry URL and redirected UK promotional landing page; represents locale routing, first impression, consent, global navigation and offer comprehension.
Primary sports-betting listing reached from the landing navigation; represents the principal product journey and dense interactive template.
Primary casino listing reached from the landing navigation; represents the game-card and category template.
Terms & Conditions destination linked from the landing footer; represents legal/help content and failure recovery.

findings.summary: The requested Botswana domain loses market context and its Terms link dead-ends.
findings.evidence: Navigation from https://www.betway.co.bw completed a four-hop redirect to https://betway.com/en-gb/ and displayed UK/£ offers. The footer Terms & Conditions URL then rendered an “Oops... page not found” page with an empty document title.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the Botswana market or show an explicit country handoff, reduce the redirect chain, and repair/version-test every legal link before publishing offers.

findings.summary: The landing page does not adapt to dark color preference.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots under default and prefers-color-scheme: dark are pixel-identical (both 627,768 bytes), including fixed light offer and consent surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide tested dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Motion continues when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched, the probe still found four running animations with durations 550ms, 1100ms and 12000ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Use prefers-reduced-motion to remove autoplay and nonessential transitions while retaining immediate state feedback.

findings.summary: Contrast preference is not meaningfully reflected.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot remains visually equivalent to the default; Lighthouse also reports a failing color-contrast audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast styles and verify text/control contrast in every overlay and promotional state.

findings.summary: State and route changes do not use view transitions.
findings.evidence: The platform probe confirms View Transitions support in the browser, while DOM/CSS inspection found no authored transition use and navigation performs full abrupt route changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive View Transitions for meaningful carousel/category/route state changes, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long content provides no scroll-linked orientation.
findings.evidence: The sports page is 10,678 CSS pixels tall, but the platform probe found zero scroll timelines and screenshots show no progress or state-aware navigation affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Use lightweight sticky/state-aware chrome or a scroll progress affordance where it helps users retain context.

findings.summary: Visible dialogs are custom and one is unnamed.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found visible DIV role=dialog surfaces, and Lighthouse failed aria-dialog-name.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the native dialog/popover primitives where appropriate and give every modal an accessible name and deterministic light-dismiss/close behavior.

findings.summary: Mobile load is delayed by redirects and excess delivery.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.5s, FCP 3.0s and estimated 1.87s redirect savings. HAR recorded 71 requests and 1,467,305 transferred bytes, including four document redirects.
findings.suggestedFix: Route directly to one canonical market URL, prioritize the LCP asset, and defer nonessential scripts/styles.

findings.summary: The sports template performs long main-thread tasks.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout observation on the sports page recorded six long tasks, including 227ms and 126ms tasks; Lighthouse reports 2.4s main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the sports bundle, split long tasks, and schedule nonessential work by priority.

findings.summary: Substantial CSS and JavaScript are shipped but unused at load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 244 KiB unused JavaScript and 19 KiB unused CSS, alongside legacy JavaScript savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template and interaction, conditionally import expensive dependencies, and remove duplicate/legacy output.

findings.summary: Some interactive elements lack robust accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed aria-dialog-name, label-content-name-mismatch and link-text; the DOM probe also found a visible dialog without aria-modal and controls with mismatched sports-themed aria labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Align visible labels and accessible names, name dialogs, and give image-only links descriptive names.

findings.summary: Text/control contrast does not consistently meet the accessibility floor.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast audit failed on the rendered landing page; the screenshots show muted grey navigation and controls over very dark backgrounds.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust semantic color tokens to meet WCAG contrast in enabled, disabled, overlay and promotional states.

findings.summary: Heading and focus semantics are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The landing page exposes two H1 elements, including “Sponsorships” and “Betway: Official Website”, while Lighthouse reports an accessibility-tree failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page-level H1, preserve a logical heading hierarchy, and regression-test keyboard focus across consent and carousel layers.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions and mostly retain legacy formats.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found all 12 images without width/height attributes, seven legacy-format images, and one missing alt value.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio, preserve responsive srcset, and negotiate AVIF/WebP where suitable.

findings.summary: Browser diagnostics report unresolved platform issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices score is 0.77 and inspector-issues failed; its report also identifies legacy JavaScript and a third-party-cookie issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve DevTools Issues, remove avoidable legacy output, and keep browser diagnostics clean in CI.

findings.summary: Not every link has meaningful crawlable text.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the link-text audit with one link, despite the page otherwise being server rendered and mobile friendly.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every linked logo/icon a concise accessible and visible-or-programmatic purpose.

findings.summary: The landing page lacks structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero JSON-LD scripts and zero Open Graph tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite/Offer structured data where eligible plus Open Graph and social-card metadata.

findings.summary: The response security policy is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows CSP and HSTS, but X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; CSP is limited to frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff, a restrictive referrer policy, a least-privilege permissions policy, and expand CSP beyond framing while testing deployment.

findings.summary: Tracking executes before consent choice and dominates the third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Before any consent action, trackers evidence found Google Tag Manager and FullStory across 11 third-party origins. HAR attributes 1,467,161 of 1,467,305 transferred bytes to origins classified third-party relative to the requested host.
findings.suggestedFix: Block nonessential analytics/session replay until opt-in, minimize collected events, and consolidate the redirect/origin architecture.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are only partially deployed.
findings.evidence: Headers inspection found no Permissions-Policy or Referrer-Policy and no nosniff; the CSP only defines frame-ancestors rather than script/object/base restrictions.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy explicit least-privilege browser policies and a full nonce/hash-based CSP in report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.summary: Asset choices waste transfer and layout work.
findings.evidence: Images evidence found seven legacy-format images and 12/12 without intrinsic dimensions; HAR records 405,316 image bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use modern responsive formats and intrinsic sizing, and avoid requesting below-fold media until needed.

findings.summary: Background analytics and replay create avoidable work.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 318,405 bytes from Google Tag Manager plus 94,341 bytes from FullStory; these load before a consent decision.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redundant tags, gate remaining analytics, batch events and deprioritize all nonessential background work.

findings.summary: Third-party code exceeds a proportionate landing-page budget.
findings.evidence: HAR records 69 of 71 requests and almost all transferred bytes as third-party relative to the requested .bw origin, with GTM, OneTrust and FullStory among the largest scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce request/byte budgets by vendor and delay media/third parties until they are necessary.

taskList.title: Repair locale routing and all legal destinations
Gate and minimize analytics/session replay before consent
Complete transport and browser security policies
Fix accessible names, contrast and heading/focus structure
Remove redirect and LCP delivery bottlenecks
Add intrinsic image sizing and modern formats
Add crawler/social metadata and descriptive links
Add progressive motion and long-page orientation
Clear browser diagnostics and legacy output
